title: The Earthquake in Miller Creek
text:
A strong earthquake shook the small town of Miller Creek early on Monday morning. Many houses lost their windows, and some roads were blocked by rocks. The town hall opened its doors, so families had a safe place to sleep that night.

The next day, volunteers came from nearby cities with food, water and blankets. Teachers helped children draw pictures about the earthquake. Workers started to repair the roads, but it took three weeks to finish the work.

questions.text: What happened early on Monday morning in Miller Creek?
options: A strong earthquake shook the town
A big flood covered the streets
A fire burned the town hall

questions.text: What did the volunteers bring to the town?
Why did families sleep at the town hall?
options: Their houses were not safe to stay in
They wanted to meet the mayor
They wanted to watch a movie

options: It was a long and difficult job
It was finished in one day

people who help others without being paid
closed so that nothing can pass
to fix something that is broken or damaged

paragraph_translations: Un terremoto fuerte sacudió el pequeño pueblo de Miller Creek temprano el lunes por la mañana. Muchas casas perdieron sus ventanas, y algunas carreteras estaban bloqueadas por rocas. El ayuntamiento abrió sus puertas, así que las familias tuvieron un lugar seguro para dormir esa noche.

Al día siguiente, voluntarios llegaron de ciudades cercanas con comida, agua y mantas. Los maestros ayudaron a los niños a dibujar sobre el terremoto. Los trabajadores empezaron a reparar las carreteras, pero tardaron tres semanas en terminar el trabajo.
